name: Ethan Bates
description: Friend from the Moira area JD has known since the mid-2010s. Saranac Lake police officer and National Guard officer.
bio: Part of the Moira-area friend group since about 2014, close with Merrick Sinclair. Serves as a National Guard officer and works as a police officer in Saranac Lake. He was an early influence on JD's decision to join the Guard.
public_footprint:
SUNY Potsdam class of 2023 graduate from North Bangor, NY. Graduated summa cum laude with a Bachelor of Arts in Music; completed SUNY Potsdam's Law Enforcement Training Institute in December 2022, receiving the Director's Award for his IT work; also played second violin in the Crane Opera Ensemble and Orchestra production.
Sources: https://potsdam.meritpages.com/stories/Ethan-Bates-Completes-SUNY-Potsdam-Law-Enforcement-Training-Institute/98200856; https://potsdam.meritpages.com/stories/Ethan-Bates-Set-to-Graduate-from-SUNY-Potsdam/108809068
